coverage: Morning Shift — Team 1 (06:35 – 14:30) · Day Shift — Team 2 (09:00 – 17:00) · Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:30 – 22:30) · Night Shift (22:30 – 06:30)

sections.title: Morning Shift — Team 1 (06:35 – 14:30)
items: Equipment received: 4x keys, 2x swipe cards, 2x bodyvests, 1x Ops phone, 2x cameras, 2x camera chargers. All photos/video involving incidents attached following end of shift.
Alpha Route commenced. Welfare check at Starbucks. All clear. Corner of Queen Street and Victoria Street checked. A few street persons sitting in front of ANZ but not causing issues.
Welfare check at Dunkin Donuts. No issues. Durham Street scoped from Queen Street. No suspicious activity. All clear.
Arrived at the corner of Queen Street and Wyndham Street. Checked thoroughly. All clear.
Arrived at the intersection of Queen Street and Shortland Street. Welfare checks on stores. All clear.
Arrived at Imperial Lane. Floor checks on ground level and Level 1. All clear. Presence maintained.
Welfare check inside McDonald's Britomart. All clear.
Arrived at Commercial Bay check-in. Full walkthrough completed. Welfare checks on stores. All clear.
Welfare check inside OK Gift Shop. All clear. Returning to TK Square.
Arrived back at TK Square. Presence maintained.
Welfare check inside Metro Woolworths and Aotea Gifts. No issues found.
Arrived at check-in, corner of Customs Street and Albert Street. Checked thoroughly. All clear.
Patrol continued up Albert Street. Welfare check at Albert Mart Convenience Store and Discount Dairy. No issues raised.
Arrived at the corner of Albert Street and Swanson Street. All clear.
Arrived at Federal Square and Cathedral Church. Walkthrough completed. All clear.
Arrived at the intersection of Albert Street and Wyndham Street. Welfare checks at Good To Go Supermarket and Hollywood Cafe. All clear.
Welfare checks at Little Albert's Cafe, Formery, Sky Mart Convenience Store, and The People's Barista. All clear.
Arrived at top of Victoria Street check-in. Welfare checks on all stores. Presence maintained before returning to headquarters.
Departed area due to no activity or problems visible.
Welfare check inside Woolworths and Chemist Warehouse Victoria Street. Stopped for drinks and checked on static guards. All clear.
Arrived at headquarters and prepared debrief for the second HOTC team.
Second HOTC team deployed. Teams split to cover both ends of the CBD (first team lower CBD, second team upper CBD).
Welfare check at Starbucks. All clear.
Arrived at the corner of Lorne Street and High Street. Welfare checks along all stores on High Street. All clear. No reports made.
Arrived at Freyberg Place and Women's Memorial Hall. All clear. A few vagrants present but usual for the area and not causing issues.
Arrived at Chancery Square check-in. Full sweep completed. All clear. Presence maintained.
Departed area due to no activity or issues visible.
Welfare check along Vulcan Lane and Lower High Street stores. All clear.
Arrived at Wilson Carpark check-in. Welfare checks on stores and static guards. All clear. Presence maintained.

Arrived at bottom of Fort Street check-in. Welfare checks at Sienna Cafe, Smiley Mart Convenience Store, Auckland Harbour Suites, Giapo, Char Grill, and surrounding stores. All clear. Presence maintained.
Departed area due to no visible concerns.
Arrived at Kiwibank check-in. Welfare checks at Mr Katsu, 77 Convenience Store, and The Coffee Club. All clear.
Welfare checks inside Tuck Shop, St Pierre's Sushi, and Queens Arcade. All clear.
Welfare checks at Four Square and Movenpick. No issues reported.
Welfare check inside McDonald's Britomart. All clear.
Welfare checks on stores and businesses within Queens Wharf. All clear.
Arrived at Commercial Bay check-in. Full walkthrough completed. Presence maintained while monitoring for response calls.
Alpha Route ended with no incidents. Charlie Route commenced.
Welfare check at OK Gift Shop. All clear.
Welfare checks at Aotea Gifts and Metro Woolworths. All clear.
Arrived at the intersection of Customs Street and Albert Street. No issues present.
Patrolling up Queen Street to maintain visible presence.
Security presence maintained at the corner of Queen Street and Wyndham Street before moving along.
Walkthrough through Durham Street while making way to High Street. Welfare checks on stores. All clear.

Response call received from Mirrou regarding a female individual and her partner committing theft, allegedly taking two skirts and a shirt. Staff felt unsafe to approach due to the female's partner being present. Photo description provided, though face was unclear.
Arrived at Mirrou. Obtained a photo description of what the female POI was wearing. Presence maintained while watching for anyone matching the description.
Response call received from 27-30 Victoria Street regarding a street vagrant obstructing the entrance to the building. Second HOTC team notified and sent to handle the situation.
Departed Mirrou and continued patrols up Queen Street towards headquarters.
Arrived at headquarters. Ops phone placed on charge due to low battery while remaining available for response calls.
Response call received from Roma Blooms regarding a male individual causing a disturbance at the top of Victoria Street. Guards proceeded to the location.
Arrived at Roma Blooms. Male POI had urinated outside beside the store and had already left. Staff advised to call immediately if he returned.
Arrived at the bottom of headquarters. Ops phone placed back on charge while remaining available for updates and response calls.
Morning shift concluded. Handover to afternoon shift completed.

sections.title: Day Shift — Team 2 (09:00 – 17:00)
items: Team 2 commenced patrols up towards Aotea Square. Welfare checks completed, all clear:
Arrived at Aotea Square check-in. Full sweep commenced.
Full sweep of Aotea Square completed. All clear. Presence maintained.
Departed standby with no issues to report.
Arrived at Mayoral Drive check-in. Welfare check with Te Waihorotiu train station guard. All clear.

Arrived at top of Victoria Street. Welfare check at 77 Convenience Store. A male vagrant became aggressive once guards appeared and was verbally abusive in his native language. The male crossed the road towards Amelia's Cafe, picked up a chair, and ran around with the chair in hand before making his way towards Hobson Street. Guards stood by due to rain and in case the POI returned.
Arrived at bottom of Victoria Street West. Welfare checks on stores down to Queen Street. All clear. Presence maintained.

While patrolling back up Queen Street, guards noticed a male vagrant yelling and disturbing World Vision volunteer workers. Guards advised him to move along so the workers could continue; he complied. Presence maintained.
Arrived at Auckland Library check-in. Full sweep completed. All clear.
Arrived at Lorne Street and Victoria Street East check-in. Welfare checks completed along Lorne Street:

Bao & Noodles, Tsujiri, and Meat Fresh reported the same POI from a previous incident dated 06/03/26 at 16:00 - female with curly brown hair and a rainbow jacket with a kitten displayed, who entered and trashed store displays (photo on file). All other stores clear. Guards also approached a male vagrant yelling outside Mecca on Queen Street and checked everything was okay; no further issues.
Security presence maintained at bottom of Victoria Street West.
Patrolled back up Victoria Street West. Welfare checks at Woolworths, Tony's Steakhouse, Scrunchy Millers, and Liquor City. All clear. Presence maintained at Albert Street and Victoria Street West.
Arrived at Aotea Square. Full sweep commenced.
Full sweep of Aotea Square completed. All clear. Returned to headquarters for combined 10-minute interval.
Team geared up to recommence routes.
Arrived at Queens Court check-in. Welfare check completed. All clear.
Arrived at Aotea Square. Response call received from Team 1 regarding a female vagrant obstructing the entrance of 27 Victoria Street West.
Arrived at 27 Victoria Street West. Female had already been moved along by Council but was spotted across the road outside 205 Queen Street.
Guards spoke with the female vagrant and informed her not to obstruct business entrances; she complied and moved along. Guards stood by in case she returned.
Arrived at Wellesley Street and Queen Street.
Arrived at Lorne Street fountain. Presence maintained.

Arrived at bottom of Victoria Street East. Presence maintained outside headquarters. Welfare checks at Puffing Kiwi, Starbucks, and Sail City Mart. All clear. Team 1 advised Team 2 to return to headquarters for Team briefing / Day in the Life of HOTC.
Briefing / Day in the Life of HOTC completed. Team commenced 30-minute meal break.

sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:30 – 22:30)
items: Afternoon shift deployed. Equipment handover completed.
Afternoon team deployed and proceeded towards Britomart.

Welfare checks on businesses from Farmers through to OPSM. Dangerfield reported a male preaching about God and being pushy towards customers and staff. The male had moved elsewhere. Guards located him near McDonald's Queen Street, spoke with him, obtained contact details, advised him not to preach inside or directly outside stores, and asked him to move further down the street.
Returned to headquarters. Ops phone placed on charge.
Alpha Route commenced. All clear, no issues.
Echo Route commenced. All clear, no issues.
Welfare check completed at McDonald's Queen Street. All clear.
Beta Route commenced. All clear, no issues.
Charlie Route commenced. All clear, no issues.
Delta Route commenced. All clear, no issues.
Afternoon shift completed. Handover to night shift completed.

sections.title: Night Shift (22:30 – 06:30)
items: Night shift deployed. Equipment received: 3x bodyvests, 2x keycards, 1x Ops phone, 4x set of keys, 1x bodycam, 1x Ops phone charger, and 2x body camera chargers.
Beta Route commenced. Welfare check at Chatime, top of Queen Street. All clear, no issues.
Welfare check at McDonald's Queen Street. All clear, no issues.
Welfare check at Victoria Street and top of High Street.
Full sweep around Freyberg Square and Chancery Square. All clear, no issues.
Security presence maintained at Freyberg Square for nearby calls and public reassurance.
Patrol through O'Connell Street, bottom of High Street, Fort Street, and White Lady. All clear, no issues.
Welfare check at Gore Street and Auckland Harbour Suites. All clear, no issues.
Beta Route completed. Delta Route commenced. Welfare check at Britomart and Commercial Bay. All clear, no issues.
Welfare check at carpark next to Chemist Warehouse. All clear, no issues.
Upper Queen Street checked. All clear, no issues.
Welfare check at Aotea Square and Mayoral Drive. All clear, no issues.
Welfare check at 77 Convenience Store on Victoria Street. All clear, no issues.
Welfare check at Albert Mart Convenience Store. All clear, no issues.
Welfare check at Customs Street and Custom Mart Convenience Store. All clear, no issues.
Welfare check at Fort Lane, Fort Street, and Jo & Joe. All clear, no issues.
Welfare check at High Street and High Street Supermarket. All clear, no issues.
Welfare check at Chancery Square, Freyberg area, and upper High Street. All clear, no issues.
Welfare check at Lorne Street and Auckland Library. All clear, no issues.
Response call received from McDonald's Queen Street regarding a trespassed male vagrant sleeping inside the lobby.

Arrived at McDonald's Queen Street. The trespassed male vagrant was still sleeping. Guards woke him and reminded him he was trespassed and needed to move along; he complied and exited without further issue.
Security presence maintained in front of McDonald's Queen Street in case the individual returned.
McDonald's Queen Street appeared clear. Patrols continued.
Check completed at Darby Street and Elliott Street. All clear, no issues.
Patrolling up Victoria Street. All clear, no issues.
Welfare check at 77 Convenience Store. All clear, no issues.
Patrolling Federal Street towards Wyndham Street. All clear, no issues.
Patrolling down Wyndham Street towards Queen Street. All clear, no issues.
Welfare check at Q Convenience Store and Custom Mart. All clear, no issues.
Patrolling Fort Lane, Fort Street, and bottom of High Street. All clear, no issues.
Welfare check at High Street Supermarket. All clear, no issues.
Full sweep around Chancery Square and Freyberg Square. All clear, no issues.
Handover to morning shift completed. Night shift concluded.
